s13_f_vagolon.see: 核对过，放大看了：他身子正对镜头，只有画面右下一条穿靴的腿（他的左腿），他的右腿该在的画面当中偏左、红色破布底下只有布和崖面，没有腿。朝向（场面稿要背后斜看）照审稿人说的算小出入，不动。
s13_f_vagolon.keep: the same composition and low camera, the red-haired horned man hanging on the cliff face with his head thrown back shouting, his raised right arm with its armoured bracer and the hand clawing the cliff edge, the rope over his shoulder, his torn bloody shirt and belts, his left forearm in plate bracing on the broken rocks at the lower left, his booted left leg on the right, the huge dark smoky hands on the cliff, the soldiers and tents and banners on the cliff top, the lightning sky, the flying rocks, the colours, rendering and finish.
s13_f_vagolon.change: his missing right leg. In the attached picture only one leg shows, the booted leg on the right side of the picture; on the left side, under the torn red cloth hanging from his belt, there is only cloth and rock, no second leg. Add his right leg: coming out from his hip under the torn red cloth, the thigh in the same dark trousers going down and to the left, the knee bent, the lower leg in a dark leather boot like the other one, the sole of the boot pushed hard against the crumbling rock ledge just right of his armoured forearm at the lower left of the picture, a few pebbles breaking off under it. He then has exactly two legs, this one braced on the rocks on the left and the existing one hanging on the right.

s13_f_espe.see: 核对过，耳坠确实挂在她左耳、头发披散没束。都是一边才有的小东西和发型，照口径不改；人体没毛病，伸出去的手五指齐。

s13_f_diwis.see: 核对过，放大看了：左上两顶伤兵帐篷的杆顶是十字，第一顶帐篷正面有大十字纹、侧面有红十字记号，担架上的红布条也成十字；右下前景那根锈铁桩是一个大十字。草地远处的桩多是分叉的木棍，不算。
s13_f_diwis.keep: the same composition and low camera, the white-haired elf kneeling in the grey grass on the left reaching up with a dagger, her scarred face and green eyes, her hooded cloak and belts, the huge horned armoured demon with long red hair seen from behind with his arm flung out toward the wall of fire, his torn bloody cloak, the burning sky, the broken wheels and stakes in the grass, the two white tents with cots in the distance at the upper left, the colours, rendering and finish.
s13_f_diwis.change: three small things. First, the two white tents at the upper left: the tops of their tent poles are crosses; make every pole a single plain straight post with no crossbar, rope running from the top. Second, on the front of the nearer tent there is a large cross shape and a red cross mark, and the cots in front of the tents have red cross-shaped stripes; make the tent cloth plain dirty white canvas with no marks, and the cot blankets plain white with one plain red band across. Third, the big rusty iron stake in the right foreground is a cross with a crossbar; make it a single broken spear shaft leaning to the left, splintered at the top, with no crossbar.

s14_f_theodora.see: 放大核对过，审稿人看错了：上面那只手拇指在画面右边、朝右下，下面那只手拇指在画面左边、朝左上，两只手都是手背朝我们，一左一右，是一双手。两只都是五指。

s14_f_yasha.see: 核对过，桥上那个男人面朝镜头，画面左边伸下来攥翼根的是他的右手，画面右上抓缆绳的是他的左手，各接各的肩，人体对。只是跟场面稿的左右手分工反了，看图的人看不出来，审稿人也说可以不改。

s15_f_bonat.see: 放大核对过，左边中段栅门后那两辆伤兵车的篷布侧面都画着红十字，前一辆最清楚。人体没毛病。
s15_f_bonat.keep: the same composition and low camera, the big red-haired man seen from behind in a torn bloody white shirt and apron hauling on the thick root of the blossoming tree with both arms, his glowing red veins, his braced legs in boots in the red earth, the axe lying in the right foreground, the wooden palisade with its torches on the left, the small figures and covered wagons along the trench at the lower left, the pink blossoms filling the sky, the colours, rendering and finish.
s15_f_bonat.change: the two covered wagons with white canvas tops at the left, beyond the palisade, in the lower left middle distance. In the attached picture each canvas side has a red cross painted on it. Remove both red crosses: the canvas is plain off-white, dirty and weathered, with only the single plain red stripe running along its lower edge as it is now. Nothing else on the wagons changes.

s15_f_baluk.see: 放大核对过，只有他左额（画面右边）一只白骨角，往上往前弯；他右额（画面左边）头发里没有角。场面稿要两只短骨角往后掠、一长一短。
s15_f_baluk.keep: the same high camera, the lilac-haired horned young man standing in the flowered grass in the middle of a ring of pale tree trunks, his right arm stretched out toward the upper left with bone blades fanning from his fingers, his dark coat with gold trim and cravat, the blood on his sleeve, the green branch growing through his chest, his boots, the ring of white bone streaks sweeping around him, the blossoming branches framing the corners, the white fence and small horned figures at the upper right, the colours, rendering and finish.
s15_f_baluk.change: his horns. In the attached picture he has only one horn, on the left side of his head as he faces us (the right side of the picture), and it curls up and forward. Give him two short pale bone horns growing from his forehead just inside the hairline, one on each side, both sweeping backward over his hair: the one on the right side of the picture as it is now but bent backward instead of forward, and a matching one on the left side of the picture, coming out of the lilac hair above his right temple, a little shorter than the other. Both horns lie back along the top of his head and do not point up into the sky.

s16_f_eudora.see: 放大核对过，三处都属实：长袍正面一排盘扣式的横扣加一圈立领；窗下墙上流出来的光字看得出2、5这样的阿拉伯数字；两扇窗板上的铁饰是四臂带尖头的十字形。
s16_f_eudora.keep: the same composition and low camera, the long-haired blue-grey woman with a long braid standing at the arched window high in the ruined stone tower, both arms raised, her bleeding hands, her open mouth and face turned up to the sky, her wide-sleeved pale robe with gold-trimmed panels and a jewelled brooch, the two dark wooden shutters swung open on either side, the great blue light pouring down the left of the sky, the floating stones, the fallen soldiers on the plain below, the colours, rendering and finish.
s16_f_eudora.change: three things. First, the front of her pale robe: in the attached picture it has a mandarin standing collar and a row of knotted frog fastenings down the chest; make it a simple round neckline edged with a narrow gold band, and replace the frog fastenings with a short row of small plain round buttons. Second, the glowing lines flowing down the stone balustrade below the window at the lower right look like numerals such as 2 and 5; turn them into flowing ribbons of golden light with no letter or number shapes, only curling streaks and dots of light running down over the stones. Third, the iron fittings on both shutters are four-armed pointed crosses; make them long plain iron hinge straps ending in a leaf-shaped scroll, with no crossing arms.

s15_f_torg.see: 放大核对过：城墙顶上靠左那一段人群里竖着一根带横梁的小十字杆，属实；墙上几面蓝旗的金纹是一朵四臂的十字形花，算十字纹。陀尔格的角又长又往上弯、跟场面稿的短粗往前弯不一样，不过衬在背后的机械上、不贴着天，不像月牙，算长相跟场面稿的出入，不改。人体没毛病。
s15_f_torg.keep: the same composition, the huge horned red-haired demon smith seen from behind pressing both bandaged hands flat on two great round shields, his bare muscular back with the leather strap and his tag-hung apron, the copper lightning climbing around him, the silver-haired knight in white and purple driving his long sword toward him from the left, the hundreds of shields flying apart, the huge carved wheel and axle at the upper right, the white wall with crystal cannons and small watchers along its top, the colours, rendering and finish.
s15_f_torg.change: two things on the white wall at the upper left. First, among the small figures standing on the top of the wall, left of the middle cannon, there is a thin staff with a crossbar like a small cross; remove it, leaving only the line of small standing figures there. Second, the long blue banners hanging down the wall carry a gold emblem shaped like a four-armed cross-flower; replace the emblem on every banner with a single plain gold horizontal band across the blue cloth, nothing else on the banner.

s16_f_sigward.see: 放大核对过：扎进他腹部的重矛露在外面、伸向画面左下的那一端是个矛尖，像两头都是尖；入口上方还多出一截短短的尖片。另外画面下方当中的小方盾上有一朵十字形金花，一并改。
s16_f_sigward.keep: the same composition and low camera, the big silver-haired man in battered patched white armour stepping forward on the stone step and cutting down with the greatsword held in both hands, his blue eyes and set face, the blood down his armour and boot, the heavy spear shaft driven into his belly, the line of light down the blade, the falling riverbank and the horned beast-riders on the right, the broken armour and the small wounded soldiers on the left, the colours, rendering and finish.
s16_f_sigward.change: three small things. First, the heavy spear in his belly: the long haft runs out of his belly toward the lower left, and in the attached picture the far end of that haft, near the lower left edge, ends in a spearhead. That end must be the plain butt of the spear: the round wooden haft simply ends in a short iron butt-cap, with no blade or point. Second, just above the haft where it enters his belly there is an extra short pointed shard; remove it, leaving only the one haft going into the bloody wound. Third, the small square shield lying in the rubble at the bottom middle has a gold four-armed cross-flower on it; make the shield face plain with only a single plain gold band across it.

s16_f_taher.see: 放大核对过：斧柄上握着三只手，当中那只（画面上方当中偏右）底下只有一截护腕，接不到任何胳膊；头上只有白火的形状，看不出角。
s16_f_taher.keep: the same composition and low camera, the huge armoured demon in the right half of the picture swinging the long-hafted axe overhead with both arms, his snarling face lit from below, his long flying hair, the white flame sheeting off his arms and the axe head, his dark scorched plate armour and torn red cloth, the bleeding cut on his left leg, the white footprints in the cracked white ground, the small woman with the long sword at the breach on the left, the fallen dark wing, the broken white wall, the burning sky, the colours, rendering and finish.
s16_f_taher.change: two things. First, the axe haft at the top of the picture is gripped by three hands: his left hand on the left end attached to his left arm, his right hand on the right end attached to his right arm, and a third gauntleted hand in the middle of the haft, above his head, with a bracer that is attached to no arm. Remove that middle hand and its bracer completely; in its place show only the bare wrapped haft and the white flame. He holds the haft with exactly two hands. Second, he has no visible horns, only white flame on his head. Inside that white flame show two great dark horns growing from his temples and sweeping back and outward behind his head, thick at the root, with the white fire burning along them.

s16_f_bjorn.see: 核对过：画面下方当中被攥着手腕往上拉的船员脸嫩、没胡子，像十几岁，额头脸颊带血。照主会话点名的改：三十来岁、络腮胡、脸上不带血。
s16_f_bjorn.keep: the same composition and camera, the big blond man with a short copper-red beard and a bloody scar on his face bracing the long mast laid across the ice hole, one hand gripping the mast, the other hand gripping the crewman's wrist and hauling him up, his tattooed forearms, his torn red cloak and leather vest, the blood at his side, the ship hanging in the hole, the sea beast and the green-blue churning water below, the crew crouching on the ice at the upper right, the burning longships and the sunset in the distance, the colours, rendering and finish.
s16_f_bjorn.change: the crewman being pulled up the hanging hull at the bottom middle of the picture, his arm up and his wrist in the big man's grip, his other hand on the rope ladder. In the attached picture his face is young and beardless and there is blood on his forehead and cheek. Make him a grown man of about thirty: a broad weathered adult face with a full dark brown beard covering his jaw and chin, short dark hair, a strained, gritted expression, and no blood or wound anywhere on his face. Keep his pose, his raised arm, his hooded green cloak and mail shirt exactly as they are.

s16_f_senati.see: 放大核对过：她只有画面右边（她左额）一只角，另一边额角没有；黑袍是一圈立领加领口正中一颗扣，有中式立领的味道。
s16_f_senati.keep: the same composition and low camera, the dark-haired demon woman rising out of the cracked white ground half sunk in it, her face turned up with violet eyes and a bloody cut, one arm reaching up toward the sword with dark clawed fingers, the other hand flat on the ground, her torn black robe and the dark smoke wisps around her, the defender's worn boots, coat hem and gloved hand with the long sword on the left, the huge axe wreathed in white flame coming down at the top, the broken white wall ends and the smoke, the colours, rendering and finish.
s16_f_senati.change: two things. First, her horns: in the attached picture she has only one horn, on the left side of her head (the right side of the picture). Give her two short dark horns, one at each temple, both sweeping straight back along her hair; the one on the right side of the picture stays where it is but shorter and bent back, and add a matching one on the left side of the picture, growing from the hair above her right temple. Second, her black robe has a high stand-up collar with a single button at the centre front; make it a plain close high neckline with no button and no collar band, the black cloth simply rising to her throat.

s16_f_mudar.see: 核对过：画面右上塔顶日轮碎成的三块，每一块都是发光的弯月牙形，贴在天上，照口径是月牙。人体没毛病。
s16_f_mudar.keep: the same composition and camera, the long-haired plum-purple demon sitting on the sand seen from behind at three-quarter with his head turned toward the sunset, one knee raised with his arm resting on it, the other hand on the sand, his long red coat with gold trim, the wound in his side and the blood on the sand, the short swept-back horns, the rose petals, the glassy crystal sand on the left, the ruined arches, the falling tower on the right, the setting sun on the horizon, the red and violet sky, the colours, rendering and finish.
s16_f_mudar.change: the broken sun disc in the sky at the upper right, beside the top of the falling tower. In the attached picture it has broken into three glowing pieces, and each piece is a curved crescent shape like a sliver of a moon. Redraw these three pieces as jagged, angular shards of a thick flat golden metal disc: each shard has straight broken edges and sharp corners, uneven in size, one of them showing the thick rim edge, glowing orange-gold at the cracks, tumbling apart with small sparks and chips between them. No curved crescent outlines.
